# Willow Lantern Dance Studio — Fictional Retrieval Handbook

This fictional handbook is effective from 1 January through 31 December 2027. It is test data, not advice or an actual studio policy. Dates and values below are intentionally explicit so retrieval can be checked against source text.

## Cancellation notice

Students must cancel a booked class at least 24 hours before its scheduled start to retain makeup eligibility. Notice is measured from the time the studio receives the cancellation, not when the student writes it. Cancelling two hours before class normally forfeits the makeup credit.

## Medical exception

A teacher may approve a medical exception to the 24-hour notice rule after reviewing a medical certificate. Approval is required before a makeup can be booked. A medical certificate does not automatically create a makeup credit.

## Makeup deadline

An approved makeup credit expires 28 calendar days after the missed class. The replacement class must take place by that deadline, including day 28. Unused credits cannot be carried into a later term unless the teacher approves an extension in writing.

## Makeup availability

A replacement class must have an available place and match the student's approved level. A waitlist place is not a confirmed booking. Families must obtain confirmation before attending a replacement class.

## Trial lessons

A new student may attend one trial lesson for AUD 18. The trial fee is credited against the first term invoice only if enrolment is completed within seven calendar days after the trial. Trials do not reserve an ongoing place.

## Term tuition

Junior Ballet tuition is AUD 240 for a ten-week term with one class per week. Tuition is due seven days before the first class of the term. Costume, examination and performance fees are charged separately.

## Sibling discount

The second enrolled sibling receives a 10 percent discount on the lower tuition fee. Trial lessons and costume charges are excluded from this discount. The sibling discount cannot be combined with the early-payment discount.

## Early payment

Invoices paid in full at least 14 days before term begins receive a 5 percent tuition discount. Payment must have cleared by the deadline. The early-payment discount cannot be combined with the sibling discount.

## Withdrawal

Families must give 14 calendar days of written notice to withdraw from ongoing enrolment. Telling another student or leaving a verbal message does not satisfy the written-notice requirement. Fees for classes inside the notice period remain payable.

## Weather closure

If the studio cancels a class because of extreme weather, the studio offers a replacement class or a credit for the cancelled lesson. Families do not need to meet the student cancellation-notice rule for a studio closure. The studio announces closures by email.

## Clothing

Junior Ballet students wear a plain leotard, ballet tights and soft ballet shoes. Hair must be secured away from the face. Outdoor shoes must be removed before entering the dance floor.

## Arrival and collection

Students should arrive ten minutes before their class starts. An authorised adult must collect children under 12 from the studio entrance. Notify the studio in writing if a different adult will collect a child.

## Photography permission

The studio requires written guardian consent before using a child's identifiable photograph in public marketing. Families can withdraw marketing consent by emailing the office. Withdrawal affects future use; it does not guarantee removal from previously printed materials.

## Accessibility

Families may request accessibility adjustments by contacting the office before the first lesson. A teacher discusses the student's needs privately and confirms practical arrangements. A diagnosis is not required simply to request that conversation.

## Examination entry

Examination entry requires the teacher's approval and a minimum attendance rate of 80 percent in the preparation term. Paying the examination fee does not guarantee approval. Examination dates are confirmed separately by the examination board.

## Lost property

Unlabelled lost property is kept for 30 calendar days and then donated where suitable. Labelled items are held while the office attempts to contact the family. The studio cannot accept responsibility for valuables left unattended.

## Contact and office hours

The office answers enquiries from 09:00 to 17:00 Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays. Send administrative questions to office@example.invalid. Teachers do not monitor the office inbox during every lesson.

## Refund requests

Refund requests must be submitted in writing to the office with the invoice number and reason. The manager reviews requests individually; submitting a request does not guarantee a refund. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within ten business days.
